create_top_p_processor: create a TopPProbabilityProcessor to filter token probabilities using nucleus sampling with a configurable top_p threshold
build_disallow_tokens_processor: build a DisallowTokensLogitsProcessor to block specific token IDs from being generated during inference
create_allow_only_tokens_processor: create an AllowOnlyTokensLogitsProcessor to restrict generation to only a specified set of allowed token IDs
build_cfg_processor: build a CFGLogitsProcessor to apply classifier-free guidance by mixing conditioned and unconditioned logits with a guidance scale
create_in_batch_cfg_processor: create an InBatchCFGLogitsProcessor to perform classifier-free guidance by chunking batch logits into conditioned and unconditioned halves
